text:
Emma L: Quick question — API contract check: when runtime returns 429 for per-route burst exhaustion, are we guaranteed to include the rate-limit headers we agreed on (X-Route-Quota, X-Route-Burst-Tokens)? Client SDKs rely on them for backoff + fallback.

Raj P: Short answer: we try to set them but there are some edgecases where only Retry-After is returned. We're debating whether to guarantee them across hosted/dedicated.

Sylvie: Is this about Dedicated/private deployments where proxies can strip headers, or hosted responses?

Raj P: Both. Dedicated sometimes runs behind customer proxies that strip non-standard headers unless passthrough is enabled. Hosted emits X-Quota-Balance and X-Burst-Tokens today.

Kevin M: SDK PR is blocked — I'm using X-Route-Burst-Tokens to show remaining burst and drive fast-retry jitter. If headers are missing, retry logic misbehaves.

Mike O: We should be conservative: clients should fallback to 429 body 'quota_hint' when headers missing. Can we make that part of the contract?

Emma L: Proposal — guarantee Retry-After and a minimal stable JSON body for 429 so SDKs have a deterministic fallback. Example:

```json
{
  "error": { "type": "rate_limited", "message": "per-route quota exceeded" },
  "hint": { "bucket": "per-route", "remaining": null, "lease_ms": null }
}
```

SDKs can prefer headers when present, otherwise use body.hint. Thoughts?

Raj P: That looks good. A couple notes: body fields must be stable and additive for backwards compatibility. Also we should not leak internal bucket ids — keep bucket names generic.

Sylvie: +1 to body fallback. For Hosted we'll emit both. For Dedicated we can add a config flag to enable header passthrough; default stays off for existing customers to avoid surprises.

Kevin M: OK — I'll update the SDK to prefer headers -> body.hint -> Retry-After, and avoid hard failures. Will also add tests.

Mike O: Can infra add a test that simulates a header-stripping proxy? And can we flip passthrough on staging?

deploy-bot: infra: flag rollout started to staging: infra/flags/route-header-passthrough -> true @12:43 UTC :rocket:

Raj P: I'll open a short spec doc and link it here (fields, header names, privacy notes). cc @Sylvie for Dedicated rollout details.

Emma L: Thanks — please include a one-paragraph privacy note and example response block for docs. Also ping @Kevin M for code-review on PR #342 :thumbsup:

Kevin M: Will PR today and add tests. Emma L: I'll grab that example and drop into docs once spec is up.
